### Specify  correlation structures
```{r}
corStructs <- list(corGaus(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corExp(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corLin(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corRatio(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE), corSpher(form = ~x+y, nugget = TRUE) )
```

#### File Paths
```{r}
out_path <-  here("Output/Spatial/GAM")
if(!dir.exists(out_path)) dir.create(out_path)
```

#### Datasets for gamms
```{r}
all_species <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/all_species.rds"))
wc <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/wc.rds"))
hs <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/hs.rds"))
#hs_no_zeros <- readRDS(here("./Data/Processed_Data/Spatial/hs_no_zeros.rds"))

# get all datasets in a list
datasets <- list(all_species, wc, hs)
names(datasets) <- c("all_species", "wc", "hs")
```

# NB method = "ML"
```{r}
gamm_selection_as <- list()

full_model_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
  s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[1]] <- full_model_gamm

# while edf of zero means smooths could be made parametric terms, it makes little difference when they are not significant. Rather just drop entirely

drop_trees_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[2]] <- drop_trees_gamm

drop_trees_pesticide_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~  s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +
  s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[3]] <- drop_trees_pesticide_gamm

drop_trees_pesticide_prec_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~  s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +
  s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[4]] <- drop_trees_pesticide_prec_gamm

drop_trees_pesticide_temp_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~  s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +
  s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[5]] <- drop_trees_pesticide_temp_gamm

filedir <- paste0(here(out_path), "/GAMM_all_species")
if(!dir.exists(filedir)) dir.create(filedir)
filepath <- paste0(filedir, "/gamm_model_select_as.rds")
filepath
write_rds(gamm_selection_as , 
          file = filepath)
```


```{r}
# If already saved, load again to make figures and output
gamm_selection_as <- readRDS(here("Output/Spatial/GAM/GAMM_all_species/gamm_model_select_as.rds"))

full_model_gamm <- gamm_selection_as[[1]]
drop_trees_gamm <- gamm_selection_as[[2]]

plot(full_model_gamm$gam, pages = 2)

gam.check(drop_trees_gamm$gam)
summary(drop_trees_gamm$gam)
plot(drop_trees_gamm$gam, pages = 2)

gam.check(drop_trees_pesticide_gamm$gam)
summary(drop_trees_pesticide_gamm$gam)
plot(drop_trees_pesticide_gamm$gam, pages = 2)

gam.check(drop_trees_pesticide_prec_gamm$gam)
summary(drop_trees_pesticide_prec_gamm$gam)
plot(drop_trees_pesticide_prec_gamm$gam, pages = 2)

gam.check(drop_trees_pesticide_temp_gamm$gam)
summary(drop_trees_pesticide_temp_gamm$gam)
plot(drop_trees_pesticide_temp_gamm$gam, pages = 2)

```

### HS

#using corGaus instead of corExp as for this, it had lower AIC

```{r}


gamm_selection_hs <- list()

#corGaus favoured by AIC



full_model_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
  s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663), 
  control=lmeCtlList,
  correlation = corStructs[[1]],
  data = datasets$hs$gamm_input)

gamm_selection_hs[[1]] <- full_model_gamm

drop_pesticide_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr")  + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663), 
  control=lmeCtlList,
  correlation = corStructs[[1]],
  data = datasets$hs$gamm_input)

gamm_selection_hs[[2]] <- drop_pesticide_gamm

    s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663), 
  control=lmeCtlList,

    s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = negbin(theta = 4.663), 
  control=lmeCtlList,

drop_pesticide_trees_temp_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +

```{r}
set.seed(0)
dat <- gamSim(6, n = 100, scale = 5, dist = "normal")

fmm1 <- uGamm(y ~s(x0)+ s(x3) + s(x2), family = gaussian, data = dat, 
    random = list(fac = ~1))

getCall(fmm1)
class(fmm1)

gam1 <- gam(y ~s(x0)+ s(x3) + s(x2), family = gaussian, data = dat)

plot(gam.hp(gam1))
plot(gam.hp(fmm1$gam, type = "dev"))


gam1$call
```


```{r}
 # "The information in the summary lme output on the fixed effects bit is not interesting neither; just use the anova(O4.gamm$gam) command for clearer information on the significance on individual terms." From Zuue et al 2009 page 339

It contains:The full likelihood of the data.The correctly estimated degrees of freedom for the random effects (the smooths).Any complex correlation structures you added (like correlation = corAR1() for time series).Because model$lme is a standard object from the nlme package, R’s core functions like AIC() and anova() know exactly how to read it. They can correctly count the parameters and calculate the exact log-likelihood to give you valid information criteria or p-values."

# NB method = "ML"

### Run full model with all smooths

```{r}
gamm_selection_as <- list()

Sys.time()
#to reach convergence
options(mgcv.vc.logrange = 5)
lmeCtlList=lmeControl(niterEM = 50)

full_model_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
  s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[1]] <- full_model_gamm

Sys.time()
```
### Drop one term at a time

```{r}


Sys.time()
#to reach convergence
options(mgcv.vc.logrange = 5)
lmeCtlList=lmeControl(niterEM = 50)
drop_temp_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~  s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
  s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[2]] <- drop_temp_gamm 

Sys.time()

drop_rain_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + 
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") +

  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
  family = "gaussian",
  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[3]] <- drop_rain_gamm

Sys.time()

   s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") +

  correlation = corStructs[[2]],

gamm_selection_as[[4]] <- drop_wet_gamm

Sys.time()

drop_ph_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr")  +

  correlation = corStructs[[2]],
  data = datasets$all_species$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_as[[5]] <- drop_ph_gamm 

Sys.time()

drop_n_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
   s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),

### hs

### This takes ages due to PQL iterating

### Run full model with all smooths

```{r}
gamm_selection_hs <- list()

Sys.time()
#to reach convergence
options(mgcv.vc.logrange = 5)
#increased iterations and evaluations https://stackoverflow.com/questions/68122117/nlminb-problem-convergence-error-code-1-message-iteration-limit-reached-wit
lmeCtlList=lmeControl(niterEM = 50, msMaxIter = 1000, msMaxEval = 1000)

full_model_gamm <- gamm(
  species.richness ~ s(mean.ann.temp, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.mean.ann.rain, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(topographic.wetness, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(ph, k = 4, bs = "cr") + 
  s(total.n, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(tree.density, k = 6, bs = "cr") +
  s(log10.pesticide.risk, k = 6, bs = "cr") + s(log10.humans, k = 6, bs = "cr"),
  method = "ML",
    family = negbin(theta = 4.663),    
  control=lmeCtlList,
  correlation = corStructs[[1]],
  data = datasets$hs$gamm_input)
gamm_selection_hs[[1]] <- full_model_gamm

Sys.time()
```

# marginal and conditional pseudo r-squared 

#" are two measures of goodness-of-fit for mixed-effects models (models that contain both fixed and random effects). The marginal \(R^{2}\) measures the variance explained by the fixed effects alone, while the conditional \(R^{2}\) measures the variance explained by both the fixed and random effects combined."

# help function claims that this represents variance explained
r.squaredGLMM(full_model_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_temp_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_rain_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_wet_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_ph_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_n_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_trees_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_pesticide_gamm$lme)
r.squaredGLMM(drop_humans_gamm$lme)
```
